name: promo-changelog
title: Changelog hub
description: A What's new trigger with an unread count and a panel of every live entry, newest first, with clips. Entries are card records in a slot; unread is per visitor and follows account stores.
docs: <PromoChangelog slot="changelog" /> in your header. Publish card records with slot 'changelog'; the eyebrow is the entry's date label (falls back to its start date). New labels clear when the visitor closes the panel.
